title: Shop Supplies Fee on a Waiting-Period Re-decision Line — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
On a waiting-period re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the shop supplies fee reimbursed follows the labor on the repair order. The fee and the labor lines are read from the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

- **Fee charged, and every customer-pay labor charge on the repair order belongs to the covered concern line:** the fee is reimbursed in full.
- **Fee charged, and the repair order also carries customer-pay labor on other concern lines:** the fee is reimbursed in proportion. The share is the covered concern line's labor charge over all customer-pay labor charged on the repair order, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.
- **Otherwise:** no shop supplies fee is reimbursed.

The covered concern line is the concern line carrying the repair order's diagnostic fee.

**Worked cases (hypothetical).**

| Shop supplies fee | Covered concern line labor charged | All customer-pay labor on the repair order | Reimbursed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31.20 | 412.00 | 412.00 | 31.20 |
| 31.20 | 412.00 | 618.00 | 31.20 times 412.00 over 618.00, which is 20.80 |
| none | 412.00 | 618.00 | 0.00 |
